newsitem.title: BULGARIA: Flood kills two Bulgarian miners, three missing.
newsitem.headline: Flood kills two Bulgarian miners, three missing.

text.p: Two Bulgarian miners drowned and three are missing after a torrent of water and mud burst into an underground gallery, the state news agency BTA said on Saturday.
The accident happened late on Friday in one of the Bobov Dol coal mines, some 45 miles (60 km) south of Sofia.
"The swell engulfed five miners. Three of them are still being searched for...The cause of the disaster is unknown and is being investigated," said BTA.
Improvement of working conditions and safety was one of several demands in a nation-wide miners' strike, which ended last week. The cash-strapped Balkan state lacks funds to upgrade antiquated mines.
